paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for automated heuristic design (AHD), enabling iterative generation and refinement of heuristics. However, the dominant paradigm embeds LLMs as narrow, fixed components, such as crossover or mutation, within heavily hand-engineered evolutionary frameworks. We argue this misapprehends LLMs. It treats them as specialized tools rather than general reasoners, constrains them to low-level operations, and underutilizes their autonomy. Moreover, the extensive human priors in these frameworks violate the bitter lesson principle that general methods scaling with computation surpass hand-crafted solutions. This raises a key question: which AHD framework designs best convert stronger LLM capabilities into better heuristics? To address this, we propose metrics for LLM-driven AHD framework handcraftedness (AHI) and intelligence conversion efficiency (ICE). Evaluating ten LLMs across three challenging combinatorial optimization problems, we obtain a notable finding that frameworks with fewer human priors consistently yield higher ICE. Based on this finding, we propose SimpleEvol, an agent-loop framework for AHD which removes nearly all human priors and allows the LLM to operate autonomously. SimpleEvol consistently achieves the highest ICE, often by a large margin. Our results challenge the trend toward complex AHD pipelines and point to a lighter and more model-centric alternative, suggesting that reducing human priors is a more effective strategy to scale up with model intelligence. The source code is available at https://github.com/HenryZhu1029/SimpleEvol-Master.
paper.title: SimpleEvol: An Agent-Loop Framework for LLM-Driven Automated Heuristic Design with Minimal Human Priors

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.
paper.title: VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization

paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving combinatorial optimization (CO) problems on graphs by learning to sample high-quality solutions. A common inference-time approach is to generate multiple candidate solutions independently and return the best-performing sample, improving solution quality at the expense of an increase in computational cost. In this work, we introduce PT-Denoise, an inference-time procedure that allows these concurrent denoising trajectories to interact through parallel tempering, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the underlying denoiser. Our method assigns a temperature to each diffusion process and allows processes to swap temperatures based on their relative performance. This dynamically reallocates promising, low-energy trajectories to colder, more concentrated sampling regimes while allowing higher-energy states to escape local minima through randomized exploration. Experiments on canonical graph-structured CO problems show that our approach consistently improves the quality of the best solution found, while only adding minimal computational overhead.
paper.title: Parallel Tempering for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization

analysis.setting: 论文研究的是 LLM 引导的进化式程序搜索问题：决策对象是多组件程序（例如多阶段重排序流水线）的组件级编辑；目标是在质量与推理服务成本之间进行多目标权衡；关键约束是搜索预算有限且需要在质量与每查询 token 消耗之间平衡；信息假设是搜索过程可记录每次编辑及其对应的指标变化，但现有方法丢弃了这些归因信息；环境为静态的离线进化搜索，摘要未说明是否存在动态扰动或在线变化。

analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题与摘要，无法确认实验的公平计算预算、基线具体配置、统计显著性、组件划分粒度以及方法在非重排序任务上的泛化性；对生产调度领域的迁移价值属于推测，需要原文方法细节与额外实验验证。
analysis.why_recommended: 对于关注进化算法与学习辅助搜索结合、多目标优化以及 LLM 驱动自动建模/程序搜索的研究者，该文提供了一种把搜索历史中的组件编辑与指标变化显式关联的机制，可用于思考如何提升搜索效率与稳定性；尽管应用领域是 LLM 重排序而非生产调度，其组件级反馈与双参照系记忆的设计具有向调度算法自动演化迁移的潜力。

paper.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search can discover complex programs, but existing methods mostly only save candidate programs and fitness scores while discarding which component edits produced which fitness metric changes. Existing methods force the mutator LLM to infer the effect of prior edits from cluttered histories, making program search slow and unstable. This is especially true for locally servable LLMs to evolve multi-component systems. We introduce component-aware feedback, which compares each evaluated program with its parent, identifies the components that changed, and logs them with the associated metric differences into an attribution memory that later mutations read. The memory keeps each change in two reference frames, local against the parent it came from and global against the seed program, which shows both the immediate effect of a change and the cumulative progress made since the seed. We study this on LLM reranking, a multi-objective optimization problem where a multi-stage pipeline must balance quality against serving cost. Across twelve \textsc{Bright} datasets, our method reaches the strongest baseline's final quality after a median of one third of the search budget and ends 7.2\% higher in held-out nDCG@10, and under a cost-aware objective it finds pipelines that are on average more accurate while using 11\% fewer tokens per query, showing component-aware feedback to be a promising direction for more efficient self-evolving systems.
paper.title: Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs

paper.abstract: Scalable robotic fleets have become increasingly popular for various applications such as package delivery, warehouse management, and military operations. Prior fleet control algorithms solve centralized routing problems with up to $1{,}000$ tasks in controlled environments, yet they fail to consider realistic constraints such as limited observation and communication ranges typical of decentralized fleets. Thus, deploying existing fleet control algorithms into real-world settings is currently infeasible. To tackle this, we propose Heterogeneous Allocation via Localized Observations (HALO) to solve the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP). HALO is a hybrid method that splits the VRP into allocation and routing portions to provide onboard, real-time solutions to robots in dynamic environments. During the allocation phase, HALO utilizes a heterogeneous graph neural network framework with unique message passing layers to explicitly separate the learning of spatial distributions and task-to-robot compatibility. Evaluation results on a partially observable, online variant of the VRP show HALO significantly outperforms the heuristic baseline while maintaining similar solution quality to an all-knowing offline variant of HALO. While HALO is explicitly designed for partially observable environments, it imposes no strict upper bound on the observation space allowing us to test HALO on the traditional static, single-depot VRP. Here, HALO outperforms state-of-the-art architectures strictly optimized for the static variant of the VRP by up to $14.06\%$. Throughout all testing, this framework maintains the quickest execution times which emphasizes its potential for large-scale, real-time deployment.

paper.abstract: Next-token prediction has driven remarkable progress in large language models, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that they can struggle on problems governed by complex global constraints. In this work, we focus on this regime and ask whether some of these limitations arise from the inference interface induced by next-token prediction itself. We study this question through blackboard intelligence: an inference-time perspective in which a model works on a fixed, revisable canvas and searches over candidate solution states rather than committing to a causal, left-to-right trajectory. We instantiate this idea with diffusion language models, whose any-order prediction interface naturally exposes predictions over partially filled solution states. Our key observation is that mean confidence, a simple model-internal quantity available from the standard masked diffusion objective, provides a useful proxy for global coherence and can guide inference-time search and revision. Empirically, across ZebraLogic, Nurse Rostering, and Job-Shop Scheduling, Blackboard consistently improves inference while holding the fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Instruct checkpoint fixed and substantially outperforms same-scale autoregressive baselines, reaching 90.4% accuracy on ZebraLogic-Hard, 76.4% exact feasibility on Nurse Rostering, and 80.2% optimality on JSSP. Stronger autoregressive search and refinement also fail to close the gap on ZebraLogic-Hard, while Blackboard surpasses tested frontier LLMs there and on JSSP despite their substantially greater scale and strong test-time reasoning. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/jwoosang1/blackboard-intelligence.
paper.title: Blackboard Intelligence Can Surpass Autoregressive on Globally Constrained Problems

paper.abstract: The two-dimensional irregular knapsack problem in a fixed circular container is an important combinatorial optimization problem for maximizing material utilization in manufacturing. Conventional geometric packing solvers can produce tightly packed layouts, yet they often partition the residual space into isolated small pockets that cannot fit valuable unplaced polygons. To overcome this late-stage packing bottleneck, we propose a failure-aware large neighborhood search framework named GeoNest, driven by a graph policy trained via reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first construct neighborhoods by pairing failed target polygons with residual pockets. We then use explanatory poses to identify the placed polygons that block candidate insertions. These diagnosed blocking relations define bounded, fixed-item repair subproblems for the underlying geometric solver. Finally, the graph policy selects the most promising subproblem for execution. For evaluation, we introduce CircleNest-Bench, a benchmark comprising 2,391 load-controlled instances from four contour sources, including a held-out industrial CAD source. Experimental results demonstrate that, under the same total time budget, GeoNest improves mean utilization over a state-of-the-art standalone packing solver by about 0.9% on average across the three main test sets and by about 0.6% on the held-out industrial set.
paper.title: GeoNest: Learning to Select Failure-Aware Neighborhoods for the Irregular Knapsack Problem in a Circular Container

paper.abstract: Optimization modeling formulates real-world decision problems as mathematical programs that solvers can use to find optimal decisions. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but the resulting correct formulations can require substantial time and memory to construct and solve, limiting practical scalability. Therefore, we systematically investigate whether LLMs can identify problem structure from natural-language descriptions and apply suitable optimization modeling techniques to generate mathematical models and solver code that solve the problems correctly and efficiently. To this end, we first curate OptTips, a knowledge base of 50 expert modeling techniques in eight families. Using this knowledge, we develop OptDachshund, a multi-agent framework that transforms problems from existing optimization benchmarks into new tasks for evaluating LLMs' use of modeling techniques. It constructs conventional and expert mathematical models with solver code for the same task and data, providing baselines for correctness and computational cost. The resulting EfficientOpt benchmark contains 561 expert-reviewed tasks with paired reference implementations. Evaluation of 11 representative LLMs reveals an efficiency gap on correctly solved tasks with comparable measurements: for every LLM, most generated programs take longer to solve than their expert counterparts. Within the comparable reference-size subset, 57\% of programs with correct objective values and fewer variables and linear constraints have longer recorded solver times. Case studies show that different modeling techniques can achieve the same optimal value at similar recorded cost. Faster solving may not reduce execution time if the code takes longer to prepare data and build the model. LLM optimization modeling should therefore be evaluated for both correctness and computational efficiency.
paper.title: Right Answers, Costly Models: The Efficiency Gap in LLM-based Optimization Modeling

analysis.analysis: 作者将自动研究过程分解为三层：审阅与构思层将任务与证据转化为结构化的研究方向池；算法搜索层把可执行实验组织成算法树并维护当前节点与前沿；验证层执行注册实验并把结果回写为可复用的研究证据。通过这种分解，候选生成与主动搜索被分离，方向切换（R）与局部精化（L）成为由历史状态驱动的显式动作。材料未说明作者是否使用问题结构下界或图表示等数学分析手段。

MILP与MINLP实例上严格改进当前最好解或达到历史目标值本身是NP难任务

analysis.insight: 有效性的关键在于把“保留多样化待探索假设”与“结构化组织可执行实验轨迹”这两件事解耦并同时维护：思想池让未被选中的方向不会因为当前方向被持续细化而丢失，算法树让每个节点携带可恢复的实验状态与工件，从而使智能体既能沿有希望的方向做局部精化，又能依据历史状态切换到替代的方法论方向。消融实验显示两个组件具有互补贡献，说明仅有多样想法或仅有结构化轨迹都不足以支撑长时程自动研究。

method: AutoMIP是一个可复用的智能体技能（agent skill），用于组织混合整数规划中的长时程自动研究。

paper.abstract: Despite recent progress in autoresearch, applying it to practical operations research problems, typically formulated as NP-hard mixed-integer linear or nonlinear programs (MILPs or MINLPs), remains challenging because effective research requires systematically managing competing ideas and long-horizon experimental trajectories. We introduce AutoMIP, a reusable agent skill for organizing long-horizon autoresearch in mixed-integer programming through idea pooling and algorithm tree search. AutoMIP maintains a persistent pool of complementary candidate ideas while organizing executable experiments into an algorithm tree, enabling the agent to preserve unexplored hypotheses, refine promising algorithms, and switch to alternative methodological directions based on historical states. On MILP and MINLP benchmark cohorts, AutoMIP achieves the highest final success rates among the evaluated autoresearch frameworks. On MIPLib, AutoMIP discovers new best solutions for 31 of 60 instances, surpassing existing autoresearch frameworks. On MINLPLib, it achieves new best solutions for 52 of 60 instances. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary contributions of idea pooling and algorithm tree search, highlighting the importance of jointly maintaining diverse research ideas and structured experimental trajectories for long-horizon autoresearch.
paper.title: Autoresearch in Mixed-Integer Linear and Nonlinear Programming

paper.abstract: Unit Commitment is a computationally demanding mixed-integer linear optimisation problem requiring many binary commitment decisions across a scheduling horizon. To reduce this computational burden, machine learning approaches can predict a subset of these decisions, thereby shrinking the search space explored by the optimisation solver. Existing confidence-based approaches determine which variables to fix based on user-defined probability thresholds, which are agnostic to the downstream optimisation problem. We address this limitation by introducing an optimisation-aware framework that yields generator-specific confidence thresholds based on the impact of fixing errors on Unit Commitment solution quality. This approach won first place in the 2025 EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition. The proposed framework achieves a mean optimality gap below 0.5% while also delivering an average speed-up of more than 20x. It therefore provides a general mechanism for translating probabilistic predictions into controlled reductions of mixed-integer search spaces, directly linking learning decisions to their downstream computational and economic consequences.
paper.title: Learning to Fix: Optimisation-Aware Machine Learning for Accelerated Unit Commitment

paper.abstract: Routing and switch placement are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems in chip design, requiring the joint optimization of routing topology and physical placement under strict structural, geometric and logical constraints. Existing approaches typically rely on carefully engineered heuristics that incorporate strong problem-specific biases to navigate the enormous space of possible designs. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for joint routing and switch placement at the level of logical communication routes. Starting from a minimal routing graph, our method progressively constructs increasingly expressive solutions through three coupled operations: switch expansion, switch placement, and route refinement. These operations preserve routing validity by construction, restricting exploration to feasible configurations where every communicating initiator-target pair has one assigned loop-free route. We explore the induced solution space using Gumbel Monte Carlo Tree Search, showing that neural-guided search substantially improves solution quality over non-learning optimization methods. Furthermore, pretraining across floorplans provides a strong initialization for fine-tuning on unseen instances.
paper.title: Validity-Preserving Hierarchical RL for Joint Routing and Switch Placement in EDA

analysis.analysis: 作者将问题结构化为带析取约束的非线性优化问题：先用位置、能量、时间间隔与充电时长等连续变量参数化整条轨迹，再以总任务时间为目标，写出物理与运行约束，其中包括统一定义的电池动态模型与对每种充电模式时间分配的析取约束。随后利用析取约束的最小值/最大值结构，构造光滑函数近似并给出近似误差上界（附录中通过 φ_p(z) 的展开与不等式推导证明），从而把含析取的结构转化为可由光滑非线性算法处理的形式，避免引入整数变量。

analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于：充电模式的切换本质上是可以由连续时间分配表达的析取结构，而非必须用整数变量建模。作者用一个统一的电池动态模型加上对每种模式所占时间的析取约束来刻画非线性充电，再通过光滑近似以有界误差替代析取约束，从而把混合整数非线性问题转化为光滑非线性规划。这样既保留了恒流—恒压等非线性充电行为的物理保真度，又使问题可由光滑非线性优化算法高效求解，并可通过理论误差界控制近似质量。

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文属于数学规划驱动的轨迹与调度协同优化，其核心机制——用统一动态模型加析取约束描述多模式切换、再用光滑近似消除整数变量以获得有界误差并交由连续非线性优化高效求解——与智能优化和生产调度中“学习辅助搜索/数学规划结合”的求解范式高度互补。论文事实：作者确实采用连续非线性规划替代混合整数非线性规划，并报告计算时间从小时级降至分钟级。迁移设想（推测）：把“模式切换→析取约束→光滑近似→连续求解”这一思路迁移到柔性作业车间或生产运输协同调度，需要把机器/车辆的状态切换（如加工、待机、充能、装卸）建模为分段时间分配变量，并验证光滑近似在离散事件与顺序约束下的可行性保持与解质量；此外，若要在动态扰动场景使用，还需额外的滚动时域或在线重优化机制，论文本身未提供该能力。
analysis.setting: 研究面向由地面移动充电站支持的无人机系统的轨迹优化问题：决策对象包括无人机在各时间戳的位置、归一化电池水平、时间间隔以及分配给移动充电站的充电时长；目标是最小化总任务时间；关键约束涵盖多个空间分布任务的完成、无人机与移动充电站之间的充电耦合、恒流—恒压非线性充电动态、移动充电站比无人机更严格的地形可达约束（限制可充电地点）、充放电阶段不同的速度上界以及电量动态平衡；信息假设为离线已知任务位置与地形信息，环境为静态确定性场景；材料未说明在线扰动、随机性或动态重规划机制。

paper.abstract: Supporting Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) with mobile charging stations enables persistent UAV autonomy in infrastructure-sparse environments. In this setting, trajectory optimization for UAVs is challenging because it couples task scheduling with when and where to recharge, as well as terrain-access constraints on where charging is available. We propose a smooth nonlinear trajectory optimization model for UAV with mobile charging support. Compared with existing results, the proposed model allows nonlinear charging dynamics mode via a unified battery dynamics model with disjunctive constraints on the time allocated to each mode. Furthermore, it provides smooth approximations of the disjunctive constraints with bounded approximation errors. By avoiding integer variables, these approximations enable efficient solution using smooth nonlinear optimization algorithms. We evaluate the proposed model on UAV missions with multiple spatially distributed tasks, nonlinear constant-current--constant-voltage charging dynamics, and terrain-access constraints on mobile charging support. Compared with mixed-integer nonlinear programs, the proposed model provides high-quality approximate solutions while reducing the computation time by orders of magnitude.
paper.title: Nonlinear Trajectory Optimization Models for Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles with Mobile Charging Support

analysis.analysis: 作者通过理论分析与实证归因相结合的方式剖析问题。首先将问题形式化为局部集合覆盖，定义局部选择器的视野半径与全局可行性组合条件。随后证明两个理论结果：确定性选择器若视野少一跳，则必然覆盖失败或与最优解相差Δ倍；L层GNN在决策节点读出时恰好是L跳选择器，说明深度不能扩展半径。反过来，在恰好2跳视野下，O(Δ)深度的GNN可复现RFC 7181覆盖贪心，O(c_max Δ)宽度可复现度量感知的加权贪心，并继承(1+ln Δ₂)近似保证。实证上，作者将可行性分析与优化解耦，通过构造性解码器保证100%覆盖，使神经编码器专注于代价优化；并通过消融、泛化与真实网络迁移检查定位视野而非容量为主要变量。
challenges: 信息视野硬约束下，确定性局部选择器可能因视野不足而无法同时满足覆盖可行性与接近最优。
加权MPR目标上，即使公平的代价有效性贪心也留下明显经验差距，学习策略需在极局部视野内超越手工启发式。
局部承诺必须组合成全局可行覆盖，需要构造性解码器将神经评分转化为保证覆盖的离散决策。
在真实营级机动网络等分布外拓扑上保持泛化能力与100%可行性。

evidence.claim: 论文研究在硬信息视野下每个节点仅依据其k跳邻域提交局部承诺并组合成全局可行覆盖的组合优化问题。
evidence.quote: We study the opposite: combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where every node commits to its share of a global solution seeing only its $k$-hop neighborhood, and those commitments must compose into a globally feasible solution.

evidence.claim: 论文实例化在OLSRv2的加权MPR选择上，其视野由协议施加而非模型设计者选择。
evidence.quote: We formalize this as local set cover and instantiate it on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of the Optimized Link State Routing Protocol version 2 (OLSRv2) routing protocol (RFC~7181), whose horizon is imposed by the protocol, not chosen by the modeler.

evidence.claim: 论文证明L层GNN在决策节点读出时恰好是L跳选择器，容量无法买回半径。
evidence.quote: an $L$-layer graph neural network (GNN) read out at the deciding node is exactly an $L$-hop selector, so capacity cannot buy back radius.

evidence.claim: 论文证明在恰好2跳视野下O(Δ)深度的GNN可复现RFC 7181覆盖贪心并继承(1+ln Δ₂)近似。
evidence.quote: Conversely, at the horizon a \ac{GNN} of depth $O(\Delta)$ reproduces the RFC~7181 covering greedy, and at width $O(c_{\max}\Delta)$ its metric-aware weighted analogue, inheriting the $(1+\ln\Delta_2)$-approximation in both cases.

evidence.claim: 3层GATv2覆盖完成解码器从CP-SAT最优行为克隆达到cost/opt=1.030±0.001，贪心为1.138，弥合79.1%差距。
evidence.quote: Empirically, a 3-layer \ac{GATv2} with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches $\text{cost}/\text{opt}=1.030\pm0.001$ against greedy's $1.138$, closing $79.1\%$ of the gap at $100\%$ coverage.

evidence.claim: 将同一学习器限制为1跳时性能坍缩至1.344，远差于贪心。
evidence.quote: Restricting the same learner to one hop, on identical instances with the same decoder and demonstrations, collapses it to $1.344$, far worse than greedy.

evidence.claim: 在200/200单位代价实例上OLSRv2未修改选择代码与基数贪心匹配，在40,308个真实营级机动实例上冻结模型在完全覆盖下弥合48%差距。
evidence.quote: OLSRv2's unmodified selection code matches our cardinality greedy on $200/200$ unit-cost instances, and on $40{,}308$ instances of real battalion mobility the frozen model closes $48\%$ of the gap at full coverage.

experiments: 实验设置：随机几何单位圆盘图，n个节点均匀分布于单位正方形，半径r内连边，链路带与长度相关的整数度量；加权MPR目标为所选中继面向中心链路度量之和；CP-SAT整数规划求解每个实例至最优，定义cost/opt=1.0。
主要结果：3层GATv2覆盖完成解码器，从CP-SAT最优行为克隆，达到cost/opt=1.030±0.001，贪心为1.138，在100%覆盖率下弥合79.1%的差距。
视野消融：将同一学习器限制为1跳，在相同实例、解码器和示范下，性能坍缩至1.344，远逊于贪心。
消融梯（E1，n=3200测试集）：随机可行1.641，无图MLP（DeepMPR式）1.218，贪心参考1.138，节点摘要代价GNN 1.057，完整GNN 1.029，CP-SAT最优1.000。
结构可行性验证（E2）：解码器包装任意评分生成启发式（包括随机与MLP）均达到完美覆盖比1.0，而原始神经输出独立无法满足覆盖约束。
泛化与迁移（E3）：n=80,r=0.30训练模型应用于n=160时弥合差距从约79%小幅降至约74%；密集网络r=0.46下降至51%，仍显著优于贪心且100%可行。
真实网络迁移：OLSRv2未修改选择代码在200/200单位代价实例上与基数贪心匹配；在40,308个真实营级机动实例上，冻结模型在完全覆盖下弥合48%的差距。
analysis.first_affiliation: cortAIx Labs, Thales Deutschland, Ditzingen, Germany
analysis.insight: 信息视野半径而非模型容量是决定性能的主导变量。在硬信息视野下，深度只能购买计算量而不能扩展可观测半径：L层GNN在决策节点读出时恰好等价于L跳选择器，任何确定性选择器若视野少一跳，则必然要么覆盖失败要么与最优解相差Δ倍。恰好达到2跳视野时，GNN可以精确复现RFC 7181的贪心规则及其(1+ln Δ₂)近似保证，因为2跳球正是协议提供的信息边界。因此，将学习组件置于该视野内的贪心骨架上，仅让网络学习代价感知的排序，就能在加权目标上超越经典局部贪心并维持构造性可行覆盖。
limitations: 信息视野设定了性能上限，深度只能购买计算量而不能扩展可观测半径。
基数目标下贪心已近最优，改进空间主要在加权目标。
加权优化剩余差距可能对特定架构选择敏感。
全局所选集合的并集形成耦合网络结构，可能受益于更大的观测半径。
method: 问题形式化：将分布式局部承诺组合问题建模为局部集合覆盖，并实例化为加权MPR选择。
理论边界：证明视野不足一小时的Δ倍最优性差距或不可行性，以及L层GNN等价于L跳选择器的容量-半径关系。
构造性覆盖解码器：将神经评分贪婪地转化为每个节点的中继选择，保证组合后100%覆盖可行性。
GATv2编码器：在2跳视野内读取局部拓扑与链路度量，输出代价感知的中继排序。
行为克隆训练：从CP-SAT整数规划最优解中克隆加权MPR决策，避免稀疏奖励与信用分配问题。
模型选择：以解码后的验证集代价比作为选择标准，直接度量部署解码而非代理损失。
analysis.motivation: 主流神经组合优化假设集中式求解器能读取整个实例，但在链路状态路由等真实网络中，每个节点只能依据有限视野做出不可撤销的局部选择，且这些选择必须组合成全局可行解。作者以此逆向设定为研究对象，探讨信息视野本身对可学习性与可解质量的根本限制，并利用路由协议提供的真实问题场景验证。
analysis.primary_topic: 硬信息视野下的图神经组合优化：以加权MPR选择为实例的局部集合覆盖
analysis.relation_to_research: 本文直接研究信息受限下的局部组合优化与神经求解器设计，属于AI4OR中学习辅助搜索与图神经网络组合优化的交叉方向。其构造性解码器保证覆盖可行性的机制，对生产调度中需严格满足工件-机器覆盖约束的场景具有迁移参考价值。作者明确将视野视为硬约束并理论刻画容量-半径关系，提示在分布式制造或生产运输协同中若决策者仅有局部信息，单纯增加网络深度可能无法弥补信息缺失。迁移设想（推测）：若将局部集合覆盖框架用于分布式车间调度，需将2跳覆盖约束替换为工件-机器-运输资源的局部可行性约束，并重新证明相应视野下的近似边界，同时验证构造性解码器能否保证调度解的全覆盖且不违反时间窗与产能约束。
analysis.setting: 研究在硬信息视野约束下的组合优化问题：全局目标是一个集合覆盖，但每个节点只能看到自身的k跳邻域并据此独立提交其局部选择，这些局部承诺必须组合成一个全局可行的覆盖。论文形式化为局部集合覆盖，并实例化在加权多点中继（MPR）选择上——这是OLSRv2路由协议（RFC 7181）中NP难的2跳覆盖问题，其视野由协议决定而非模型设计者选择。目标是使所选中继集的代价（如ETX或能量等链路度量）最小化，同时保证2跳邻域全覆盖。决策是每个节点的局部选择，约束是每个2跳邻居必须被至少一个被选中继覆盖，信息假设是每个节点仅能获知其k跳邻域，静态环境（随机几何单位圆盘图与真实营级机动网络）。
analysis.title_zh: 局部学习覆盖：硬信息视野下的图神经组合优化
analysis.uncertainty: 全文节选覆盖了摘要、引言、实验与方法表格及结论，但部分理论证明细节、网络架构超参数、训练开销与公平计算预算的完整对比在节选中缺失，因此对理论保证的适用条件和训练成本无法完全核实。此外，真实营级机动基准的具体拓扑特性与分布外泛化机制的证据仅限于节选描述，需查阅原文补充。
analysis.why_recommended: 该论文将信息视野作为核心变量，从理论上澄清了图神经网络深度与可观测半径的区别，并把可行性保障下沉到构造性解码器，这与生产调度中约束可行性优先、公平计算预算和泛化能力的研究关切高度一致。其实验设计包含严格的精确最优基线、视野消融、结构可行性验证和真实网络迁移，可为智能优化研究者提供方法论参考：在局部决策不可撤销且必须组合成全局可行解时，如何分离可行性保证与代价优化，以及如何评估有限信息下学习辅助搜索的真实收益。

paper.abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization typically assumes a centralized solver that reads the whole instance. We study the opposite: combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where every node commits to its share of a global solution seeing only its $k$-hop neighborhood, and those commitments must compose into a globally feasible solution. We formalize this as local set cover and instantiate it on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of the Optimized Link State Routing Protocol version 2 (OLSRv2) routing protocol (RFC~7181), whose horizon is imposed by the protocol, not chosen by the modeler. We prove two results. Any deterministic selector whose horizon is one hop short must either fail coverage or land a factor $\Delta$ from optimal, and an $L$-layer graph neural network (GNN) read out at the deciding node is exactly an $L$-hop selector, so capacity cannot buy back radius. Conversely, at the horizon a \ac{GNN} of depth $O(\Delta)$ reproduces the RFC~7181 covering greedy, and at width $O(c_{\max}\Delta)$ its metric-aware weighted analogue, inheriting the $(1+\ln\Delta_2)$-approximation in both cases. Empirically, a 3-layer \ac{GATv2} with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches $\text{cost}/\text{opt}=1.030\pm0.001$ against greedy's $1.138$, closing $79.1\%$ of the gap at $100\%$ coverage. Restricting the same learner to one hop, on identical instances with the same decoder and demonstrations, collapses it to $1.344$, far worse than greedy. Two transfer checks target real-world networks. OLSRv2's unmodified selection code matches our cardinality greedy on $200/200$ unit-cost instances, and on $40{,}308$ instances of real battalion mobility the frozen model closes $48\%$ of the gap at full coverage. The information horizon, not the model capacity, is the most significant variable.
paper.title: Learning to Cover Locally: Graph Neural Combinatorial Optimization under a Hard Information Horizon

paper.abstract: The rapid proliferation of data centers (DCs), driven by cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI), has led to massive energy demand and carbon emissions, posing significant sustainability challenges. Carbon-aware optimization in geographically distributed data centers has been widely studied. Most existing approaches mainly focus on operational carbon emissions from server usage. However, existing literature often ignores workload-induced thermal stress, which accelerates nonlinear hardware degradation. This leads to more frequent server replacements and ultimately increases embodied carbon emissions. To address these limitations, we propose a comprehensive carbon life-cycle modeling framework for distributed data centers. Apart from operational carbon emissions, this work combines workload scheduling with a utilization-dependent exponential aging model to evaluate long-term carbon costs from server degradation. In order to solve the proposed optimization model in an online and privacy-preserving manner, an enhanced Lyapunov framework with time-varying queue shifting (TVQS) is first introduced to handle system uncertainties. Then, a zero-sum perturbation-based alternating direction method of multipliers (ZSP-ADMM) framework is developed to enable distributed coordination across geographically separated data centers while protecting locally exchanged workload information. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves up to 13.0% lower carbon emissions and 12.6% lower operational costs compared with benchmarks.
paper.title: Aging-Aware Online Distributed Scheduling for Lifecycle Carbon Reduction in Geo-Distributed Data Centers

analysis.analysis: 作者从 MILP 的等价重构出发做理论刻画：先刻画对所有输入实例有效的仿射重构，指出其可分解为 re-description（保持变量不变，仅改写约束系统）与 substitution（类型保持的仿射变量替换，可预测地变换变量），并据此推导变量嵌入应满足的不变性与等变性归纳偏置，再把这一结构转化为对比式自监督目标。节选未给出定理细节与证明步骤。

analysis.insight: 把求解问题本身的结构对称性当作监督信号：MILP 的保整性重构分成两类——不改变变量、只改写约束系统的 re-description，以及可预测地变换变量的 substitution。前者要求变量嵌入不变，后者要求嵌入按已知变换等变，因此一个普通对比目标是错误的，必须采用等变自监督来同时编码这两种几何关系，从而在不依赖求解器标签的情况下把已知重构行为编码进隐空间。

analysis.motivation: MILP 可建模能源、交通、物流等大量真实决策问题，但大规模 MILP 求解依然计算昂贵，因此已有工作尝试把机器学习嵌入求解流程（如引导分支或预测高质量部分解）。这些方法需要能够捕捉可复用问题结构的通用 MILP 表示，而 MILP 没有规范形式：同一问题可用不同单位、二进制约定或变量参数化表达，得到的公式系数与界不同，但解集由仿射映射相联系，这一等价性可作为自监督信号。
analysis.primary_topic: MILP 变量与约束的图神经网络表示学习（等价重构自监督）
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：该工作直接面向 MILP 求解流水线中的学习组件，用等价重构作为自监督，学到可跨任务复用的变量/约束图表示，并预测分支与部分解等下游任务使用这类表示，属于 AI4OR 中“学习辅助求解”的表示学习基础层。迁移设想（推测）：其不变性/等变性思路可类比迁移到生产调度问题——例如柔性作业车间或流水车间的工序—机器二分图、分布式制造中的工厂—任务分配图、生产运输协同中的多资源耦合结构，若这些模型存在保可行性的变量替换或冗余约束重写，可用其作为自监督信号预训练调度图编码器；迁移条件是需要先证明对应重构保持调度可行域、能区分“纯重写”与“变量替换”两类变换，并验证在动态扰动与多目标约束下表示仍具泛化性。此外，该工作只学表示、不直接嵌入搜索或构造可行调度，若要与进化算法或数学规划求解器结合，还需额外的学习辅助搜索或约束处理机制，以上均为推测而非作者结论。
analysis.setting: 研究对象是混合整数线性规划（MILP）的通用变量级与约束级表示学习问题；决策对象为 MILP 二分图上的变量节点与约束节点的嵌入，目标是学到在保整性的仿射重构下具有不变性与等变性的通用表示，可用于多种下游 MILP 任务；关键约束是所利用的重构必须保持整数可行域、必须对任意输入实例有效，且不使用求解器产生的标签；信息假设为可获得等价重构对并知道所施加的重构形式。环境为静态离线预训练，论文摘要与节选未说明在线或动态扰动求解环境。

paper.abstract: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embeddings transform under changes of variables. Without solver-derived labels, ReMILP learns representations that exhibit the intended invariance and equivariance on unseen problem classes. Across binary solution, constraint activity and integrality gap prediction, these representations carry task-relevant information when frozen and provide a useful initialization for fine-tuning.
paper.title: Reformulation-Contrastive Learning for Mixed Integer Programs

paper.abstract: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.
paper.title: OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework

APGEM控制器作为上下文感知编排层，基于量子态保真度、策略熵、累计奖励和近似比等策略级指标，从ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM中在线选择缓解技术

analysis.motivation: 现有误差缓解技术通常作为固定校正统一施加，无法适应NISQ噪声的动态变化和训练阶段的演化，导致缓解效果次优并影响QRL策略优化与学习稳定性。作者希望设计一种上下文感知的编排层，在训练过程中持续识别并应用最合适的缓解策略。
analysis.primary_topic: 量子强化学习中的自适应误差缓解编排，用于组合优化（CVRP）
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：该工作将强化学习与组合优化（CVRP）结合，使用策略梯度训练变分量子策略，并以上下文老虎机在线编排误差缓解，涉及约束可行解码与学习稳定性评估。推测：其‘用策略级指标驱动缓解技术动态选择’的编排思路可迁移到经典生产调度或FJSP中学习辅助搜索的算子/参数在线选择，但需要将量子噪声上下文替换为调度求解过程中的状态特征（如解质量、约束违反率、搜索停滞信号），并重新定义动作池与奖励；这一迁移属于推测，论文本身未涉及生产调度。
analysis.setting: 研究面向NISQ量子硬件上的量子强化学习（QRL），决策对象是在混合量子-经典训练循环中为参数化量子电路策略动态选择误差缓解技术；目标是在退相干、门不完美和测量误差条件下提升策略质量与学习稳定性；关键约束包括硬可行CVRP解码、噪声模型多样性、固定缓解技术池（ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM）以及在线选择开销；信息假设为可获取量子态保真度、策略熵、累计奖励和近似比等策略级指标；环境为带噪声仿真下的静态CVRP实例训练过程，材料未说明是否涉及真实硬件动态扰动。

analysis.why_recommended: 对关注学习辅助搜索、在线算法选择和生产调度中动态参数控制的博士生而言，该文提供了将‘控制器选择’嵌入学习闭环并用量化指标驱动决策的完整范例；其关于公平比较（静态基线、oracle参考、消融、统计检验）和遗憾分解的做法可启发调度算法的实验设计；同时需注意其量子领域特殊性，迁移到经典调度需重新论证。

paper.abstract: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. APGEM evaluates Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) using policy-level indicators, including quantum-state fidelity, policy entropy, cumulative reward, and approximation ratio, and integrates the selected strategy directly into the reinforcement learning loop. The framework is evaluated on the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a representative NP-hard problem in urban logistics, under a range of NISQ noise models and noise levels. APGEM consistently outperforms conventional static mitigation methods, reaches approximately 94% of the utility of an oracle strategy, maintains higher quantum-state fidelity as noise increases, and produces more stable learning behaviour throughout training. Ablation studies show that the framework learns context-aware mitigation policies that adapt to different noise environments and circuit execution conditions. These findings demonstrate that integrating adaptive error mitigation into the learning process substantially improves the robustness and reliability of QRL on NISQ hardware.
paper.title: Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems

analysis.analysis: 作者将构造式求解建模为逐步决策过程，把每个rollout的多步前向计算视为可复用的资源。通过对比传统动态嵌入基线在相邻步和首步的嵌入余弦相似度，作者分析了表示在构造过程中的演化特性，指出基线存在较大的相邻步波动、且与首步表示较相似，而MiLoop在相邻步间保持强连续性并随步数形成累积变化。消融实验进一步分离了当前信息融合与门控记忆更新对跨尺度泛化的互补作用。

如何在不做训练时搜索空间剪枝的情况下保持强化学习训练效率
如何选择性保留历史信息而不被过时或无关表示干扰
如何在从100到1000万节点的巨大规模范围内保持解质量和泛化能力

evidence.quote: enabling a three-layer policy to learn effective dynamic embeddings without external solution labels or training-time search-space pruning

analysis.insight: 构造式rollout本身已经包含多步前向计算，这些计算中的历史表示可以被选择性地传播和复用，而不必在每一步丢弃并从头重建。通过在注意力层之前将当前嵌入与历史记忆融合、在注意力层之后进行自适应门控更新，浅层策略即可获得跨步的表示连续性，从而在保持对当前子问题敏感的同时积累结构信息，替代深层每步重计算。
limitations: 作者在结论中指出未来将探索更有效的记忆融合与更新机制以进一步改进渐进式表示复用

在注意力层之后，应用自适应门控更新对表示进行选择性保留与更新，更新后的表示既用于当前决策也供后续步复用
采用纯强化学习训练（主实验使用轨迹级比较的DPO式偏好优化，并评估了REINFORCE变体），利用rollout的解质量作为反馈，不使用外部解标签或伪标签，不做训练时搜索空间剪枝

analysis.motivation: 现有动态嵌入方法在每一步都用深层注意力栈从头重建子问题表示，计算开销大；许多高性能方法依赖解标签或伪标签训练，或在强化学习中进行激进的搜索空间剪枝，限制了适用性和泛化能力。作者希望仅用纯强化学习、不依赖外部标签、不做训练时搜索空间剪枝的前提下，让浅层策略也能学到有效的动态嵌入。
analysis.primary_topic: 基于强化学习的构造式神经组合优化中的记忆传播机制
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接研究构造式神经组合优化中的强化学习求解框架，与智能优化和AI4OR方向相关。其选择性记忆传播机制——即利用rollout多步计算中的历史表示进行跨步复用、通过门控融合减少每步深层重计算——在方法论上可迁移至生产调度问题的构造式求解，例如柔性作业车间调度中逐步安排工序、流水车间中逐步确定加工顺序、或分布式制造中逐步分配任务。迁移所需条件包括：将调度问题的状态和动作空间映射为图或序列表示，设计合适的可行性掩码保证约束满足，以及验证浅层记忆传播在调度约束下的表示连续性是否仍成立。需要指出的是，论文未涉及生产调度、动态扰动、多目标或能效等本方向关注的具体问题，上述迁移属于推测。
analysis.setting: 论文研究组合优化问题（COP）的构造式神经求解，决策对象是在每个构造步选择下一个节点或元素以逐步构建可行解，目标是最小化目标函数 f(y|G)，关键约束为解的可行性（y∈Ω(G)），信息假设为仅使用强化学习rollout中产生的解质量反馈而不依赖外部解标签或伪标签，环境为静态的组合优化问题实例（未说明动态扰动），实例规模从100到1000万节点。
analysis.title_zh: MiLoop：面向神经组合优化的选择性记忆传播
analysis.uncertainty: 论文全文节选不完整，缺失大量实验数据（如全部基线的完整结果、训练开销、超参数设置）、附录中的训练细节和更多消融结果。部分表格数据在节选中被截断，无法确认MiLoop在所有规模和所有问题上的完整表现。此外，论文未涉及生产调度场景，其方法向调度问题的迁移可行性尚需验证。
analysis.why_recommended: 论文提出的记忆传播机制为构造式神经求解器提供了一种降低每步重计算开销、同时保持跨尺度泛化的思路，这与生产调度中大规模实例的快速求解需求相关。浅层策略加记忆复用的设计对计算资源受限场景有参考价值。消融实验清晰分离了融合与门控的贡献，方法论上对学习辅助搜索和强化学习求解器的表示设计有借鉴意义。此外，论文在4类COP上验证到千万节点规模，其泛化评估思路对调度问题的跨规模泛化研究有启发。

paper.abstract: Constructive neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has emerged as a promising paradigm that learns to construct solutions to combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) step by step, which reduces reliance on handcrafted rules and enables fast inference. While many methods with dynamic embeddings generalize well, they typically rebuild subproblem representations from scratch at each step using deep attention stacks. Many high-performing methods in this category rely on solution labels or pseudo-labels for efficient training, or on aggressive search space pruning during reinforcement learning (RL). To address these limitations, we propose Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop), a purely RL-based constructive framework that leverages the multi-step computation already required by a rollout for selective memory propagation. Each rollout provides solution-quality feedback for learning while propagating historical representations, thereby enabling a shallow policy to learn effective dynamic embeddings without external solution labels or training-time search-space pruning. Specifically, MiLoop fuses current embeddings with historical memory before the attention layers and applies adaptive gated updates afterward. The updated representations support both current decisions and stepwise reuse. Extensive experiments across four COPs demonstrate that MiLoop consistently produces high-quality solutions on instances ranging from 100 to 10 million nodes, highlighting its strong generalization ability.
paper.title: MiLoop: Selective Memory Propagation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者将 MIO 原始启发式建模为在受限子空间（节点）上的局部搜索与线性松弛求解，并借鉴 restrict-and-relax search 与 Local-MIP 的固定/轻固定策略。通过分析节点间无包含关系导致界传播低效的缺点，提出深度下潜与界传播的节点生成策略加以缓解；同时利用解池信息设计共识重启和精英策略来指导变量固定/释放。在 GPU 侧，将线性松弛和局部搜索的代数操作批处理化，实现多节点并行探索；在 CPU 侧维护解池并做节点保留/剪枝决策。作者还讨论了与分支定界并行运行的集成可能。
challenges: GPU 并行化 MIO 原始启发式仍处于早期，缺乏通用框架
节点生成策略的结构化与非结构化权衡：非结构化快速生成深节点但使界传播等预处理效率降低
在受限子问题（部分变量固定）上实现高效局部搜索
GPU 与 CPU 之间的数据通信与解池同步开销
公平计算预算下节点并行带来的额外开销是否可接受

evidence.claim: 论文提出 PaNGEA，一种 GPU 友好的 MIO 原始启发式，结合线性松弛求解与 GPU 局部搜索。
evidence.quote: we introduce the Parallel Node Generation and Exploration Algorithm (PaNGEA), a GPU-friendly MIO primal heuristic. PaNGEA explores restricted subproblems by combining linear-relaxation solves with a local-search procedure designed for efficient batched execution on GPUs.

evidence.claim: 在 283 个 MIPcc26 和 MIPLIB 实例上，单节点 GPU 实现相比 CPU 降低平均 gap integral 8–18%。
evidence.quote: on 283 MIPcc26 and MIPLIB instances, implementing a single-node primal heuristic on the GPU reduces the average gap integral by 8-18% relative to its CPU counterpart.

evidence.claim: 并行生成和探索多个节点进一步降低平均 gap integral 12–19%。
evidence.quote: generating and exploring multiple nodes in parallel further reduces the average gap integral by 12-19%.

evidence.claim: 第一单位为 London Business School。
evidence.quote: London Business School, jpauphilet@london.edu London Business School, yupengw@london.edu

experiments: 在 283 个 MIPcc26 和 MIPLIB 实例上测试。
单一节点的原始启发式在 GPU 上实现相比 CPU 对应实现，平均 gap integral 降低 8–18%。
并行生成和探索多个节点进一步降低平均 gap integral 12–19%。
在 MIPcc26 和 MIPLIB 基准上，该设计在非商业方法中取得最强性能。
报告了线性松弛和分支定界相关指标，包括节点迭代次数、非超时率等，并比较了批处理与顺序执行的差异。
与分支定界并行运行的集成实验见附录 D，但摘要和节选中未给出具体数值。
未提供训练开销、公平计算预算的详细对比、泛化到其他问题类的实验以及消融研究的完整数据。
analysis.insight: 核心洞察是将启发式选择问题转化为批量的启发式探索：与其依赖单一节点生成规则，不如利用 GPU 批次能力同时生成并评估多个候选节点，从最有潜力的节点继续搜索。这一设计之所以有效，是因为 GPU 擅长并行求解大量小型线性松弛和局部搜索操作，而多节点并行分散了对单一下降路径的依赖，增加了找到高质量可行解的概率。同时，对 Local-MIP 的两阶段实现使受限子问题上的局部搜索更高效。
limitations: 未使用结构化节点生成策略，导致界传播等预处理技术效率降低，因为节点与其子节点间无明确包含关系。
实现与分支定界结合时可更好利用界传播等技术，但当前实现中仍有改进空间。
method: 算法为独立原始启发式，不依赖 MIO 求解器，结合线性松弛求解与 GPU 友好的局部搜索过程。
在受限子问题（节点）上实现两阶段 Local-MIP：第一阶段在 GPU 上高效执行大量简单代数操作进行局部搜索，第二阶段处理固定坐标以提升解质量。
节点生成策略包括：局部搜索后按坐标变化成本 s_j = r_j (x_j^LS - x_j^LP) 选择最低成本坐标进行固定/轻固定（典型固定比例 4%）；下潜策略随机选择分数变量并求解两个线性松弛后固定到更紧的一侧；共识重启策略利用 CPU 解池，若 80% 解中某二元变量取同一值则固定；精英策略对已固定二元坐标做释放/再固定。
并行节点生成与探索：利用 GPU 批处理能力同时生成和评估多个候选节点，从最有希望的节点继续迭代。
节点保留决策：比较节点下界与当前最优解以剪枝次优节点，类似分支定界的界限剪枝但节点间无结构化包含关系。
与分支定界并行集成的设想：在每轮迭代中同时批量探索分支定界节点与 PaNGEA 节点，以提高线性松弛求解的批处理效率和计算效率（实现见附录 D）。
analysis.motivation: MIO 求解中原始启发式能尽早找到高质量可行解以剪枝；现有 GPU 加速优化工作主要集中在连续优化，将 GPU 并行化用于 MIO 原始启发式仍是开放挑战。作者希望利用 GPU 的批处理能力不仅加速单节点计算，更并行生成和探索多个子问题以提升解质量。
analysis.primary_topic: 混合整数优化的 GPU 加速原始启发式算法
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文直接研究 MIO 原始启发式的 GPU 加速，属于数学规划与硬件加速交叉方向。对于智能优化与生产调度研究，其并行节点生成与批处理局部搜索的思想可迁移至需要大量局部搜索或子问题求解的调度问题（如柔性作业车间中邻域搜索的并行化），但生产调度通常涉及更复杂的约束结构与多目标，需适配约束可行性检查与多目标评价机制；GPU 批处理对图结构或序列决策的调度问题迁移需要重新设计状态表示（此为推测）。论文未涉及神经网络、强化学习或大模型智能体，但 GPU 并行多节点探索的架构与多智能体并行搜索有概念上的相似性，可作为学习辅助搜索中并行采样与评估的硬件加速基础（此为推测）。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为一般混合整数线性优化问题 min c^T x s.t. Ax ≤ b, ℓ^0 ≤ x ≤ u^0, x_j ∈ Z (∀j∈I)，目标是利用 GPU 并行能力设计原始启发式以快速找到高质量可行解，从而加速分支定界求解。决策对象为整数变量取值及节点（子问题）的变量界。关键约束为线性约束、变量界和整数性。信息假设方面，算法为独立启发式，不依赖 MIO 求解器，但利用 CPU 上的解池与 GPU 上的线性松弛求解。环境为静态单次求解场景，未讨论动态扰动或在线调整。
analysis.title_zh: PaNGEA：GPU 上的并行节点生成与探索算法
analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据摘要和有限全文节选，未获取完整的方法细节、实验配置、公平计算预算比较和消融数据；对应作者信息在节选中未明确标注；与分支定界集成的具体性能增益缺少数值；迁移到生产调度问题的可行性属于推测，未经验证。
analysis.why_recommended: 该工作展示了如何利用 GPU 批处理能力并行生成和探索多个 MIO 子问题，并给出了在标准基准上 gap integral 的量化改进，其“以批量探索替代单一路径”的思想对学习辅助搜索、进化算法与数学规划结合中的并行子问题求解具有参考价值。此外，对节点生成策略的分析（结构化与非结构化的权衡）有助于思考约束可行性、下界剪枝与搜索效率之间的平衡，尽管论文本身不涉及神经网络或强化学习，其并行求解架构可为智能优化中的并行搜索设计提供硬件层面的启示。

paper.abstract: Primal heuristics for finding high-quality feasible solutions are an important component in mixed-integer optimization (MIO) solvers. Recent advances in GPU-accelerated optimization algorithms show the potential of GPU acceleration for continuous optimization. In this paper, we introduce the Parallel Node Generation and Exploration Algorithm (PaNGEA), a GPU-friendly MIO primal heuristic. PaNGEA explores restricted subproblems by combining linear-relaxation solves with a local-search procedure designed for efficient batched execution on GPUs. In addition, instead of relying on a single heuristic for iterative variable fixing, we leverage GPU batching capabilities to generate and explore multiple subproblems in parallel. PaNGEA leverages GPU capabilities in two ways. First, on 283 MIPcc26 and MIPLIB instances, implementing a single-node primal heuristic on the GPU reduces the average gap integral by 8-18% relative to its CPU counterpart. Second, generating and exploring multiple nodes in parallel further reduces the average gap integral by 12-19%.
paper.title: PaNGEA: Parallel Node Generation and Exploration Algorithm on GPU

analysis.analysis: 作者从问题结构出发，把每个查询的任务图编码为节点级执行器与验证的联合二值变量 z_t^i(a,η)，先将已知质量/成本/延迟统计下的 oracle 情形建模为每查询 MILP（目标为期望执行与验证成本之和，约束含预算、每查询延迟机会约束与变量域）；再在质量未知时把节点级质量估计替换为在线学习得到的估计值，并加入信息增益 bonus 以刻画验证对学习的价值，从而将原问题分解为逐查询求解的 MILP 序列加上在线估计更新；理论上在自然假设下证明当验证足够频繁但不挤占执行时，质量学习 regret 为次线性。
challenges: LLM 对子任务的服务质量事前未知且随机，反馈需付费
需在长期预算与每查询延迟约束下做在线序列决策
执行与验证需联合决策，验证还承担学习信号角色
既要保证每轮延迟可行性，又要为未来学习预留预算
需在理论上保证质量学习 regret 不随轮数线性增长

evidence.claim: 论文研究在长期预算与每查询延迟约束下联合分配执行器并选择付费验证的在线框架
evidence.quote: We propose JOVE, an online framework that jointly assigns executor LLMs and selects intermediate outputs for paid verification.

evidence.claim: 验证异步运行并用于改进未来分配，需要平衡当前执行支出与未来学习
evidence.quote: Verification runs asynchronously and is used to improve future allocations, so the system must balance spending on execution now against learning for later.

evidence.claim: JOVE 通过求解一系列每查询混合整数线性规划来做出执行与验证决策
evidence.quote: JOVE makes execution and verification decisions by solving a sequence of per-query mixed-integer linear programs.

evidence.claim: 在线学习基于验证反馈更新任务相关质量估计，并用信息增益 bonus 把学习价值纳入分配决策
evidence.quote: Online learning updates task-dependent estimates of LLM quality based on verification feedback, while an information-gain bonus incorporates the value of learning into allocation decisions.

evidence.claim: 作者在自然假设下建立了次线性质量学习 regret
evidence.quote: Under a natural set of assumptions, we establish sublinear quality-learning regret for JOVE.

evidence.claim: 实验报告在四个推理基准上取得有竞争力准确率，且平均成本与延迟至少降低 3.17 倍
evidence.quote: Across four reasoning benchmarks, JOVE achieves competitive accuracy against standard inference baselines while reducing average cost and latency by at least 3.17 times.

evidence.claim: 问题设定包含长期预算、每查询延迟机会约束以及随机且初始未知的质量、成本与执行时间
evidence.quote: with stochastic, initially unknown LLM service quality, invocation costs, and execution times.

experiments: 在四个推理基准（Bamboogle、MMLU-Pro、LiveBench-Reasoning、GPQA）上评估，结果为三个随机种子的均值±标准差
与标准推理基线（Direct、CoT、SoT、Plato）及资源感知方法（WR-Online、Knapsack-ascend、Knapsack-descend）比较
报告 JOVE 在四个基准上取得有竞争力的准确率（如 GPQA 52.7±2.8，MMLU-Pro 54.8±1.1，LiveBench-Reasoning 41.3±1.2，Bamboogle 49.3±1.0）
摘要称相对标准推理基线平均成本与延迟至少降低 3.17 倍；正文称成本降低 3.7–16.3 倍、延迟降低 8.3–17.0 倍
包含消融研究考察不同验证权重与资源约束的影响；材料提到 JOVE single-node 变体，并指出经验上在测试范围内对验证权重 k_v 敏感度有限
材料未说明训练开销、公平计算预算细节与泛化实验的完整设置
analysis.first_affiliation: 得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（University of Texas at Austin）
analysis.insight: 贡献有效性来自将“当前执行”与“未来学习”的权衡显式编码进每轮决策：验证虽然增加当前成本且不改变本轮响应，但当模型质量未知时它能提供标签、改善后续分配；通过在 MILP 目标中加入信息增益奖励项，把验证的探索价值与执行成本/质量估计统一在同一优化框架中，并利用验证异步执行不阻塞响应的特性，从而在长期预算内实现质量学习与资源节省。
limitations: 材料提到条件 T ≥ 8d log(8n_max) 是保守的，减小 d 可降低该阈值并可能加速学习，但会限制质量模型表达能力、可能降低预测精度；并指出未给出最优 k_v 的确定方法，但经验上在测试范围内对验证权重敏感度有限
其余局限材料未说明
method: 输入：每个查询由 planner 分解出的 DAG 任务图，节点为子任务，边为依赖，并为每个节点给出候选执行器 LLM 集合
决策变量：z_t^i(a,η) 联合编码节点 i 选择执行器 a 且验证标志 η∈{0,1}，每节点恰好选一个组合
目标：最小化期望执行成本与付费验证成本之和（加 planner 成本），质量以中间结果可靠性的加性代理刻画，并叠加信息增益奖励项
约束：长期执行/验证预算、每查询延迟机会约束、变量取值域
求解：每轮查询求解一个混合整数线性规划（MILP）得到分配与验证选择
学习：验证异步执行产生的反馈用于更新任务相关的 LLM 质量估计，信息增益 bonus 把学习价值纳入分配决策
理论：在自然假设下证明质量学习的次线性 regret，并指出验证频率需足够学习但不应挤占执行
analysis.motivation: 复杂推理查询可分解为 DAG 并分布到异构 LLM 上以并行降低延迟、让小模型处理子任务，但某个 LLM 对某子任务是否合适事前未知，且仅执行并不能揭示输出正确性；在现实中获取质量反馈需要裁判模型或人工评估并产生额外成本。已有路由与图感知分配方法通常从离线数据学习或假设每次调用后免费获得质量反馈，因此作者提出在资源约束下联合选择执行器并决定付费验证哪些节点输出，以平衡当前查询性能与为未来分配而学习。
analysis.primary_topic: 资源受限下 LLM 任务图的在线执行器分配与付费验证联合决策（MILP + 在线学习）
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文事实层面研究的是 LLM 任务图上的资源受限执行器分配与付费验证联合在线决策，使用每查询 MILP 与在线学习/信息增益奖励，理论上给出子线性 regret。它与智能优化、生产调度、AI4OR 的关系主要体现在可迁移的机制：长期预算 + 每查询延迟机会约束下的在线分配、把“为未来学习而付出的探索”显式建模为决策变量、以及用 MILP 求解带组合选择的序列决策，这些与生产调度中的资源受限任务分配、机器选择与验证/质检决策在结构上相似。推测上，若要迁移到柔性作业车间、分布式制造或生产运输协同，需要把任务图节点替换为工序/运输任务、执行器替换为机器/车辆、验证替换为抽检或质量反馈，并重新定义质量估计与延迟/工期约束，且需验证质量学习反馈在生产场景中是否可低成本获得；这些迁移属于推测，并非作者结论。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为：给定一个由 planner 将复杂推理查询分解得到的 DAG 任务图，系统需要在长期执行/验证预算约束与每查询延迟机会约束下，为每个子任务节点选择执行器 LLM，并决定哪些节点的中间输出送付费验证。决策对象是每轮查询的节点级执行器分配与验证选择；目标是最小化成本/提升最终答案质量（用中间结果可靠性的加性代理刻画），同时满足每查询延迟约束；关键约束包括长期预算上限、每查询延迟机会约束、每个节点只能选一个执行器且验证变量为二值；信息假设是各 LLM 对给定子任务的服务质量、调用成本与执行时间初始未知且随机，只能通过付费验证反馈逐步学习；环境是随时间到达查询序列的在线动态环境（每轮查询图与候选执行器可能不同），验证异步进行不阻塞当前响应。
analysis.title_zh: JOVE：面向资源感知 LLM 任务图的联合执行与验证
analysis.uncertainty: 全文为节选，缺少完整的 MILP 公式细节、在线学习更新规则、完整实验表格与消融数字，因此对方法的具体实现、理论假设的完整表述、训练开销与公平计算预算等判断存在不确定性；相关性评分基于其约束决策与在线学习机制的可迁移性，而非其研究对象（LLM 推理）与生产调度的直接重合度。
analysis.why_recommended: 对做 AI4OR 与生产调度的研究者而言，该文提供了一个把“当前执行 vs 未来学习”的探索-利用权衡形式化为每轮 MILP 并附信息增益奖励的清晰范例，其长期预算与每查询延迟机会约束的建模方式、验证作为学习信号的设定、以及子线性 regret 的理论分析，可启发资源受限调度中质检/验证决策与在线学习的结合；即便对象是 LLM 任务图而非车间任务，其约束结构（预算、延迟、组合分配）与求解框架具有可迁移的参考价值。

figures.caption: Overview of JOVE. A planner decomposes each query into a task graph and identifies candidate executor LLMs for each node. JOVE jointly assigns executors and selects outputs for verification, subject to a long-term execution/verification budget and latency constraints. Verification proceeds asynchronously without delaying the current response, improving model-quality estimates.
figures.label: Figure 1

paper.abstract: Complex reasoning queries can be decomposed into directed acyclic task graphs and distributed across heterogeneous LLMs, reducing latency through parallelism and enabling smaller models to solve complex tasks. In practice, however, the suitability of an LLM for a given subtask may be a priori unknown, and execution alone does not reveal output correctness. We propose JOVE, an online framework that jointly assigns executor LLMs and selects intermediate outputs for paid verification. Verification runs asynchronously and is used to improve future allocations, so the system must balance spending on execution now against learning for later. We study how to optimize this trade-off under a long-term budget and a per-query latency constraint, with stochastic, initially unknown LLM service quality, invocation costs, and execution times. JOVE makes execution and verification decisions by solving a sequence of per-query mixed-integer linear programs. Online learning updates task-dependent estimates of LLM quality based on verification feedback, while an information-gain bonus incorporates the value of learning into allocation decisions. Under a natural set of assumptions, we establish sublinear quality-learning regret for JOVE. Across four reasoning benchmarks, JOVE achieves competitive accuracy against standard inference baselines while reducing average cost and latency by at least 3.17 times.
paper.title: JOVE: Joint Execution and Verification for Resource-Aware LLM Task Graphs

analysis.analysis: 作者通过定义任务（为某一优化问题设计启发式）、区分任务特定 AHD 与跨任务 AHD 来分析问题，并引入基于跨任务种群性能的迁移差距来量化任务间可迁移性，从而指导任务种群的交互；再以互补覆盖准则分析启发式集合的构建。材料未说明更具体的问题结构分解或下界分析。
challenges: 启发式搜索通常依赖被优化问题本身的评估反馈，难以在无目标反馈下泛化
如何在多个任务间决定哪些任务应交互并有效迁移启发式
如何在保持集合紧凑的同时覆盖多样化的源任务组合
在同一设计预算下同时提升 ID 与 OOD 性能

evidence.claim: 论文提出 MECo，一个由大语言模型驱动的多任务进化框架，用于零样本跨问题泛化
evidence.quote: We introduce MECo, an LLM-driven multi-task evolutionary framework for zero-shot cross-problem generalization.

evidence.claim: MECo 维护任务条件下的启发式种群，并使用基于跨任务种群性能的迁移差距指导交互
evidence.quote: MECo maintains task-conditioned heuristic populations and uses a transfer gap based on cross-task population performance to guide their interactions.

evidence.claim: 互补选择准则通过奖励每个成员对源任务组合的额外覆盖来构造紧凑启发式集合
evidence.quote: A complementary selection criterion then constructs a compact heuristic set by rewarding each member’s additional coverage of source combinations.

evidence.claim: 选出的集合直接应用于目标问题而不进行进一步搜索或适配
evidence.quote: The selected set is applied to target problems without further search or adaptation.

evidence.claim: 在 VRP 与 FJSP 的 32 个问题变体上，MECo 在相同预算下平均代价低于八种 AHD 基线
evidence.quote: Experiments on 32 problem variants across vehicle routing (VRP) and flexible job-shop scheduling (FJSP) show that MECo achieves the lowest mean costs compared with eight automated heuristic design (AHD) baselines under the same budgets.

evidence.claim: 在异域问题上 MECo 优于各家族中最强基线
evidence.quote: On out-of-domain problems, it outperforms the strongest baseline in each family.

evidence.claim: 将 MECo 框架与不同 AHD 方法结合可提升其 ID 与 OOD 性能
evidence.quote: Moreover, integrating the framework of MECo with different AHD methods improves their ID and OOD performance in both families, supporting its effectiveness across different methods.

evidence.claim: 仅有源任务反馈、不使用目标评估，是跨问题泛化的核心挑战
evidence.quote: Generalizing to new problem definitions using only source-task feedback therefore remains a central challenge.

experiments: 在 VRP 与 FJSP 两个族共 32 个问题变体上比较 MECo 与八种自动化启发式设计（AHD）基线，相同预算下 MECo 平均代价最低
在异域（OOD）问题上，MECo 在两个族中均优于各自最强的基线
将 MECo 框架与 EoH、ReEvo、HSEvo 结合后，其 ID 与 OOD 性能在两个族中均有提升（见表 3 报告的平均值与标准差）
报告中提到平均排名 1.12、平均相对差距 0.02%（在 16 个变体上接近最佳观测方法），并给出图 4 中相对 MECo 的 OOD 平均代价
训练开销、公平计算预算的具体描述、消融实验细节与泛化到未测试问题的证据在提供材料中未完整说明
analysis.first_affiliation: 南方科技大学自动化与智能制造学院
analysis.insight: 让多个任务条件下的启发式种群在搜索过程中交互、迁移和重组，并利用基于跨任务种群性能的“迁移差距”来决定交互方向，可以使启发式在源任务之间共享可迁移的结构；同时再以“对源任务组合的额外覆盖”为选择准则构造紧凑启发式集合，从而在目标问题上无需任何额外搜索或适配即可零样本应用。
limitations: 材料未说明
method: MECo 维护任务条件下的启发式种群（task-conditioned heuristic populations）
利用基于跨任务种群性能的 transfer gap 指导种群间交互
交互实现启发式的迁移与重组（transfer and recombination）
互补选择准则通过奖励每个成员对源任务组合的额外覆盖来构造紧凑启发式集合
选出的启发式集合直接应用到目标问题，不进行进一步搜索或适配
可将 EoH、ReEvo、HSEvo 等 AHD 的启发式生成与种群更新规则嵌入 MECo 的任务种群，MECo 决定哪些任务交互并传递父代启发式初始化组合任务种群
analysis.motivation: 为多样化的组合优化问题设计有效启发式需要大量领域专业知识与反复搜索。大语言模型虽然可以自动化启发式生成与改进，但启发式搜索通常依赖被优化问题本身的评估反馈，因此仅使用源任务反馈泛化到新问题定义仍是核心挑战。作者希望缓解新问题变体出现时启发式需要重新适配或重新设计的反复成本。

paper.abstract: Designing effective heuristics for diverse combinatorial optimization problems requires substantial expertise and repeated search. Large language models (LLMs) automate heuristic generation and refinement, but heuristic search typically depends on evaluation feedback from the problem being optimized. Generalizing to new problem definitions using only source-task feedback therefore remains a central challenge. We introduce MECo, an LLM-driven multi-task evolutionary framework for zero-shot cross-problem generalization. MECo maintains task-conditioned heuristic populations and uses a transfer gap based on cross-task population performance to guide their interactions. These interactions enable the transfer and recombination of heuristics. A complementary selection criterion then constructs a compact heuristic set by rewarding each member's additional coverage of source combinations. The selected set is applied to target problems without further search or adaptation. Experiments on 32 problem variants across vehicle routing (VRP) and flexible job-shop scheduling (FJSP) show that MECo achieves the lowest mean costs compared with eight automated heuristic design (AHD) baselines under the same budgets. On out-of-domain problems, it outperforms the strongest baseline in each family. Moreover, integrating the framework of MECo with different AHD methods improves their ID and OOD performance in both families, supporting its effectiveness across different methods.
paper.title: Multi-Task Evolution for Zero-Shot Cross-Problem Generalization using LLMs

paper.abstract: We develop a cutting-plane algorithm for computing pure Nash equilibria in finite integer games with shared constraints, where a deviation may be feasible against one opponent profile and infeasible against another. Conditional equilibrium inequalities capture this dependence through an explicit activation term. We give affine encodings of costs and activation conditions and prove that the resulting inequalities characterize the equilibrium set exactly. Embedded as lazy constraints in branch-and-cut, they yield the Generalized Zero-Regret algorithm for optimizing a linear objective over exact or approximate equilibria; a bisection procedure maintains certified bounds on the smallest achievable approximation factor. We also prove that, when the conditional polytopes have integral vertices, a concave cost is constant on the minimal face containing an equilibrium strategy, so strict concavity forces vertex strategies; for uniform integer-splittable bin packing, a cost-preserving transformation yields vertex equilibria even without strict concavity. We give formulations for bin packing, network formation, and knapsack games with shared capacities and evaluate the algorithm on 3,300 instances, computing a socially optimal equilibrium on all but 43, certifying nonexistence on 16, and certifying approximation factors within a few percent where no exact equilibrium exists.
paper.title: Computing Equilibria in Integer Programming Games with Shared Constraints

paper.abstract: Serving an LLM means setting dozens of inference-time knobs, from per-layer KV retention to per-layer expert counts. Practice sets them with mechanism-specific heuristics that return a single operating point and do not scale to layer-wise search spaces. We recast inference configuration as constrained multi-objective black-box optimization and build InferOpt, a reusable search framework that requires only variable bounds, a deterministic resource cost, and an evaluation hook. InferOpt searches on a frozen sampled proxy set, rejects over-budget candidates before any model call, tightens the budget adaptively, and re-validates Pareto representatives on full-scale dataset. One pipeline covers a 28-dimensional continuous KV space (Qwen2.5-7B) and a 26-dimensional discrete MoE space (DeepSeek-V2-Lite). On KV, post-prefill pruning cuts the 16K cache by 64.4% and TPOT by 22.9--48.5%, and the searched layer-wise budget by InferOpt beats a matched uniform budget by 7.3% and 14.0% of the Full KV reference points. On MoE, a searched top-k schedule by InferOpt removes 43.0% of routed token--expert pairs while staying within 0.59 points of the default, closer than the matched-budget baselines. Against Random Search, NSGA-II, and MOTPE, InferOpt leads on both spaces, taking the best proxy hypervolume and the lowest retention on KV and staying closest to the uncompressed reference at the lowest experts on MoE.
paper.title: InferOpt: Constrained Multi-Objective Search for LLM Inference Configurations

paper.abstract: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.
paper.title: Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction

analysis.primary_topic: 大模型/多智能体驱动的自动运筹建模，面向描述歧义与逻辑不一致的修复
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：AMAO 直接面向自动运筹问题求解，核心是多智能体与大模型协作处理自然语言描述中的歧义与逻辑不一致，再衔接形式化与编码。推测：这与智能优化和生产调度存在明确迁移路径，例如在柔性作业车间、流水车间或分布式制造中，把用户或现场给出的工序约束、设备能力、运输时间和扰动信息视为可能不一致的输入描述，用逻辑对齐与源充分性验证先修复模型输入，再交由调度求解器或学习辅助搜索求解；迁移条件是能够为调度领域定义变量、参数、目标、约束层面的对齐规则，并建立可验证的证据源，否则无法保证修复的忠实性。该论文未涉及强化学习策略、进化算法或数学规划求解器内部机制。
analysis.setting: 论文研究真实场景中由利益相关者用不完整知识和模糊表达描述的运筹优化问题：这类描述因存在逻辑不一致而无法直接形式化建模，因此自动求解需要在形式化和编码之前先行处理歧义与不一致。决策对象是给定的自然语言问题描述及其含混之处，目标是产出一致、可支撑建模的描述并进一步完成形式化与编码；关键约束是修复必须以原始描述中的证据为依据，证据不足时不得凭空补全，而应通过交互向用户索取信息；信息假设是描述可能不完整、含歧义且逻辑不一致；静态或动态环境材料未说明。

analysis.why_recommended: 对研究 AI4OR 和自动建模的博士生而言，该工作把自动运筹的瓶颈定位在描述层的逻辑不一致与证据充分性，而非仅提升建模准确率，这对生产调度中常见的模糊需求、动态扰动描述和不完整约束信息具有直接启发。其两阶段对齐、源充分性验证与按需交互修复的机制，可作为学习辅助搜索或大模型智能体进入调度求解流水线之前的前处理模块加以借鉴，且摘要给出了错误恢复与求解准确率指标，便于评估迁移价值与可复现性需求。

paper.abstract: Operations research (OR) problems are often described by stakeholders with incomplete knowledge and vague expressions in real-world settings. Such ambiguous descriptions can not be used to formulation directly. Thus, automating OR problems solving requires processing this logical inconsistency in advance. To address this challenge, we propose an \textbf{A}mbiguity-Aware \textbf{M}ulti-Agent Framework for \textbf{A}utomated \textbf{O}R Problem Solving, \textbf{AMAO}, which first addresses logical inconsistency through two-stage alignment before downstream formulation and coding. Specifically, a logical alignment agent with OR-guided experts structure first produces an aligned candidate using supervised routing over variables, parameters, objectives, and constraints. Then, a source-sufficiency verifier determines whether the original description supports the required repairs. When evidence is insufficient, an interactive repair agent requests additional information and revises the description before modeling and coding. In addition, an ambiguity-aware benchmark and its matched dialogue extension are proposed to support evaluation of both stages. The 32B model achieved 86.8\% error-recovery success and 60.4\% solution accuracy, reaching 1.98 and 1.86 times the respective base-model scores. The 8B model achieved 47.9\% solution accuracy, exceeding the best evaluated variant such as DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Claude-sonnet-4.5. Interactive repair further achieved 90.71\% complete-description accuracy when cases requiring clarification. These results support combining context-based repair with evidence assessment and targeted user clarification for automated OR modeling.
paper.title: Ambiguity-Aware Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Operations Research under Logical Inconsistency

analysis.analysis: 作者通过跨CO基准、AHD方法和主干LLM的系统性实证来刻画可行性振荡模式，并追踪其来源：分析显示可行性退化常发生在大型求解器修订之后，同时反馈冗余使得失败归因困难。基于这一结构性观察，作者将精化过程重新表述为对修订方向与修订范围的双重控制问题，用代表性失败证据选择引导更新方向，并用可行行为的累积程度驱动修订范围的渐进收窄。
challenges: LLM迭代修订求解器时容易破坏已验证的可行行为，造成可行性振荡
全量反馈中存在大量冗余，难以定位真正值得关注的失败案例
需要在不放弃求解质量改进的前提下控制修订幅度
需要平衡反馈信息量与每次修订范围以降低token消耗

evidence.claim: 论文刻画了LLM在自动启发式设计中迭代修订求解器时出现的可行性振荡现象
evidence.quote: We characterize this pattern as feasibility oscillation and document it across CO benchmarks, AHD methods, and backbone LLMs.

evidence.claim: 可行性退化常伴随大幅求解器修订，而反馈冗余使得难以定位关键失败
evidence.quote: Tracing this oscillation, our analysis reveals that feasibility degradation often follows large solver revisions, while substantial feedback redundancy makes it harder to identify which failures deserve attention.

evidence.claim: 论文提出DiSH，对修订方向与范围进行联合控制
evidence.quote: we introduce DiSH, a harness that jointly controls revision direction and scope.

evidence.claim: DiSH选取代表性失败证据引导更新，并随可行行为累积逐步收窄修订范围
evidence.quote: It selects representative failure evidence to guide each update and progressively narrows the revision scope as feasible behavior accumulates.

evidence.claim: 在九个CO基准上DiSH提升QYI并减少可行性振荡，同时将反馈token消耗减半
evidence.quote: Across nine CO benchmarks, DiSH consistently improves QYI scores and reduces feasibility oscillation, while roughly halving feedback token consumption relative to prior methods that use full feedback.

experiments: 在九个组合优化基准上进行评估
相比使用全量反馈的先前方法，DiSH持续提升QYI分数并减少可行性振荡
相对先前方法大约将反馈token消耗减半
analysis.insight: 可行性振荡的根源不在于LLM本身缺乏能力，而在于修订的幅度与反馈信息的利用方式：大幅修订容易推翻已验证的可行行为，而全量反馈淹没了真正重要的失败信号。因此，通过选取有代表性的失败证据来引导每次更新、并随着可行行为累积逐步收窄修订范围，可以在不牺牲改进能力的前提下稳定精化轨迹并降低反馈开销，这解释为何方向与范围的联合控制比单纯增加反馈或增大模型更有效。
limitations: 摘要未报告具体CO基准名称、实例规模、基线方法细节与统计显著性
摘要未说明QYI分数的具体定义与计算方式
摘要未提供训练或推理时间开销、超参数敏感性以及消融实验的详细结果
摘要未讨论该控制框架对动态扰动、多目标场景或分布式制造的适用性
method: 提出DiSH控制框架，对LLM求解器精化过程同时施加修订方向控制和修订范围控制
从执行与验证反馈中选取具有代表性的失败证据来引导每一次更新
随着可行行为逐步累积，渐进收窄修订范围以保护已验证的求解器行为
在每次修订中利用执行与验证反馈进行迭代，但以受控方向和范围替代全量反馈驱动的修改
analysis.motivation: LLM智能体在AHD中迭代修订求解器时，常常破坏此前已验证的求解器行为，导致精化过程不稳定且代价高昂；作者将这一现象刻画为可行性振荡，并观察到可行性退化往往伴随大幅求解器修订，同时大量反馈冗余使得难以识别哪些失败应优先关注，因此需要一种能够同时控制修订方向与范围的控制机制。
analysis.primary_topic: 大语言模型驱动的自动启发式设计中的可行性振荡抑制
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文直接研究LLM智能体在组合优化自动启发式设计中的求解器精化，属于AI4OR与学习辅助搜索的交叉方向。其方向-范围控制机制与可行性振荡的刻画，与生产调度中学习辅助搜索的约束可行性维护、公平计算预算以及精化稳定性问题存在明确的方法迁移路径：若将该控制机制用于柔性作业车间或分布式调度，需要把可行性判据替换为调度约束满足性，把失败证据定义为不可行或劣质调度方案，并验证在动态扰动下代表性失败选择与范围收窄策略是否仍然有效；这些迁移属于推测，尚未被作者验证。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是在组合优化（CO）的自动启发式设计（AHD）中，让LLM智能体通过执行与验证反馈迭代修订求解器；决策对象是每次修订的方向与范围，目标是在提升求解质量（QYI分数）的同时抑制可行性退化并降低反馈成本；关键约束是必须保持已验证的可行求解器行为、避免修订破坏既有可行性，信息假设是智能体只能获得执行与验证反馈而无法直接获知哪些失败最值得关注，环境为静态的九个CO基准上的迭代式离线精化过程，但摘要未明确说明是否涉及动态实例或在线扰动。
analysis.title_zh: 利用具有方向-范围控制的大语言模型进行组合求解器精化
analysis.uncertainty: 证据仅来自标题与摘要，未提供全文，因此方法细节、实验设置、基线公平性、QYI定义和统计结果无法核实；对生产调度场景的迁移判断属于推测，无法确认作者是否讨论过动态扰动或多目标约束。
analysis.why_recommended: 对研究智能优化与AI4OR的博士生而言，该论文把LLM智能体迭代精化求解器时的不稳定性上升为可度量的可行性振荡问题，并给出可迁移的控制思路：用代表性失败证据引导修订方向、用可行行为累积控制修订范围。这一机制与学习辅助搜索中的约束维护、计算预算分配和搜索稳定性直接相关，其跨九个基准、跨多种AHD方法与主干LLM的实证设计也提供了评估泛化性与反馈效率的参考范式。

figures.caption: Overview of the DiSH framework. DiSH converts evaluation feedback into two complementary controls over what to revise and how extensively to revise it. Scope control adjusts the permitted revision magnitude, while direction control selects representative failures and successful instances to focus the revision. Together, they form the revision prompt that guides the LLM to repair remaining failures while preserving previously feasible behavior across iterations.
figures.label: Figure 2

paper.abstract: Harnesses are increasingly unlocking the potential of large language model (LLM) agents by making their actions more controllable. In automatic heuristic design (AHD) for combinatorial optimization (CO), LLMs iteratively revise solvers using execution and verification feedback. However, these revisions often break previously validated solver behavior, making refinement unstable and costly. We characterize this pattern as feasibility oscillation and document it across CO benchmarks, AHD methods, and backbone LLMs. Tracing this oscillation, our analysis reveals that feasibility degradation often follows large solver revisions, while substantial feedback redundancy makes it harder to identify which failures deserve attention. Motivated by these findings, we introduce DiSH, a harness that jointly controls revision direction and scope. It selects representative failure evidence to guide each update and progressively narrows the revision scope as feasible behavior accumulates. Across nine CO benchmarks, DiSH consistently improves QYI scores and reduces feasibility oscillation, while roughly halving feedback token consumption relative to prior methods that use full feedback. These results establish DiSH as a strong baseline for solver refinement under harness control.

paper.title: Harnessing LLMs with Direction-Scope Control for Combinatorial Solver Refinement

analysis.analysis: 作者将参数化 MINLP 的求解分解为整数预测与连续精炼两个阶段：先让神经网络输出整数解的分布与对应连续热启动，再固定整数变量，用可微的弹性信赖域 SQP 层在固定迭代次数内精炼连续变量。作者同时指出，预测模型可生成多个候选整数解，每个候选配对连续初始化，以缓解单一预测不准确带来的风险。关于如何利用问题结构设计下界、图表示或分解策略，材料未说明。
challenges: 离散决策与连续变量的耦合使问题同时具有组合复杂性和非线性非凸性，松弛较弱、分支定界搜索困难
神经网络直接预测解容易产生不可行或高度次优的结果
传统混合整数 SQP 难以在固定迭代次数内有效执行，且需要大量问题特定调参
训练 SQP 层需要可微的优化过程，涉及曲率正则化与步长等参数的学习
随 SQP 层数增加，训练与推理开销上升，且高维问题的训练数据生成与前向/反向传播都可能变得昂贵

evidence.claim: 论文提出一种学习型优化框架，用于求解模型预测控制与轨迹优化中出现的参数化混合整数非线性规划
evidence.quote: We propose a learning-to-optimize framework for solving parametric mixed-integer nonlinear programs arising in model predictive control and trajectory optimization.

evidence.claim: 方法将神经网络预测与序列二次规划精炼层结合
evidence.quote: The proposed method combines neural network prediction with a sequential quadratic programming (SQP) refinement layer.

evidence.claim: 神经网络预测整数解与相容的连续热启动，并通过多个候选应对预测不准确
evidence.quote: To account for prediction inaccuracies, the trained predictor generates multiple candidate integer solutions, each paired with a continuous initialization.

evidence.claim: 固定整数解后，可微 SQP 层在固定迭代次数内精炼连续变量，SQP 层参数被训练以改善每次迭代后的可行性与目标值
evidence.quote: The integer solutions are then fixed, and a differentiable SQP layer refines the associated continuous variables over a prescribed number of iterations. The SQP-layer parameters, including the curvature regularization and step size, are trained to improve both feasibility and objective value after every iteration.

evidence.claim: 分离整数预测与连续精炼提升了鲁棒性并维持可预测的计算预算
evidence.quote: By separating integer prediction from continuous optimization-based refinement, the proposed framework improves robustness to imperfect neural predictions while maintaining a predictable computational budget.

evidence.claim: 方法在平面推箱的接触与轨迹优化示例上得到演示
evidence.quote: We demonstrate the proposed framework on contact and trajectory optimization for a planar box-pushing example.

experiments: 在平面推箱（planar box-pushing）的接触调度与轨迹优化问题上验证所提框架
与 GUROBI 进行运行时间对比：GUROBI 平均约 395.29 秒；所提 L2O 方法在候选数 B 与 SQP 层数 K 不同组合下平均时间从约 0.07 秒到 0.92 秒不等
候选数与 SQP 层数增加时运行时间上升，体现计算成本与解质量之间的权衡
作者报告所提框架相对仅使用神经网络预测器在解质量上有改善，并降低了求解 MINLP 所需的计算量
材料未提供目标值具体数值、约束可行性比例、训练开销、消融实验或泛化实验的详细数据
analysis.first_affiliation: 宾夕法尼亚大学电气与系统工程系
analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于将整数预测与连续优化精炼解耦：神经网络只负责给出多个候选整数解及其对应的连续热启动，整数变量固定后，可微 SQP 层以可控的固定迭代次数精炼连续变量，并通过训练 SQP 层的曲率正则化与步长参数，使每次迭代后的可行性和目标值都得到改善。这种分工让不完美的整数预测仍有机会通过多候选与优化层修正，同时避免了直接端到端预测解时容易出现的不可行或次优问题。
limitations: 随着 SQP 层数增加，训练和推理成本上升
扩展到高维问题仍然困难，生成足够高质量的训练数据可能不易，且通过 QP 层的前向与反向传播可能变得计算昂贵
method: 神经网络整数预测器 NN^z_φ(θ) 以问题参数 θ 为输入，输出关于可行整数解分布的 logits ℓ(θ)
由整数分布采样或选择多个候选整数解 ẑ(θ)，每个候选配对一个连续变量热启动
固定整数解后，使用固定数量的可微弹性信赖域 SQP 层对连续变量进行精炼
SQP 层中可训练参数包括曲率正则化和步长，训练目标为改善每次迭代后的可行性与目标值
训练采用监督与自监督损失相结合的方式，整体为两阶段训练框架
最终在多个候选精炼结果中进行候选选择
analysis.motivation: 混合整数优化在自动驾驶、机器人、混合系统的控制应用中自然出现，但实时求解混合整数程序需要同时应对离散优化的组合复杂性和连续优化的计算负担，传统混合整数 SQP 等算法难以在固定迭代次数内稳定执行且需要大量问题特定调参。已有监督学习方法主要面向混合整数凸规划，泛化与可行性难以保证；自监督学习虽能通过惩罚约束违反提高可行性，却可能因梯度训练陷入较差局部最优而得到高度次优解。为此，作者希望构建一种对神经网络预测误差更鲁棒、且计算预算可预测的学习型优化框架。
analysis.primary_topic: 学习型优化求解参数化混合整数非线性规划
analysis.relation_to_research: 本文属于学习辅助优化与求解器结合的方向，与智能优化、生产调度和 AI4OR 中的学习辅助搜索、神经网络与数学规划结合的研究主题相邻。其核心机制——神经网络预测离散决策、多候选生成、可微连续优化层精炼、固定计算预算——在方法层面具有可迁移性。推测可将类似框架迁移到柔性作业车间或分布式生产调度中，将机器选择、工序排序等离散决策交给神经网络预测，再用连续优化或调度规则精炼，但迁移需要满足以下条件：调度问题的离散决策维度可能远高于本文示例，训练数据生成难度更大，且需要设计适合调度约束的连续精炼层与可行性保证机制。本文并未研究生产调度问题，上述关联属于迁移设想。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为求解一类参数化混合整数最优控制问题（MIOCP），问题出现在模型预测控制与轨迹优化场景中，决策对象包括系统状态 x_t、连续控制输入 u_t 和整数决策变量 z_t，目标是在控制时域 H 上使终端与阶段代价之和最小，约束包括等式动力学约束 h(x,z;θ)=0、不等式约束 g(x,z;θ)≤0 和整数约束 z∈Z，问题参数 θ 可包括初始状态、目标状态以及其他任务或环境相关量。信息假设为参数已知，环境性质（静态或动态）材料未说明。

paper.abstract: We propose a learning-to-optimize framework for solving parametric mixed-integer nonlinear programs arising in model predictive control and trajectory optimization. The proposed method combines neural network prediction with a sequential quadratic programming (SQP) refinement layer. First, neural networks are trained using a combination of supervised and self-supervised losses to predict integer solutions together with compatible continuous warm starts. To account for prediction inaccuracies, the trained predictor generates multiple candidate integer solutions, each paired with a continuous initialization. The integer solutions are then fixed, and a differentiable SQP layer refines the associated continuous variables over a prescribed number of iterations. The SQP-layer parameters, including the curvature regularization and step size, are trained to improve both feasibility and objective value after every iteration. By separating integer prediction from continuous optimization-based refinement, the proposed framework improves robustness to imperfect neural predictions while maintaining a predictable computational budget. We demonstrate the proposed framework on contact and trajectory optimization for a planar box-pushing example.
paper.title: Learning to Solve Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programming with Neural Networks and Sequential Quadratic Programming Refinement

analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于：该问题的困难性并非源于图的复杂结构（如大量交叉边或高度数节点），因为即使限制在平面图且最大度为三时 W[SAT]-hardness 仍然成立；真正的困难性来自多分量瓶颈目标本身带来的组合结构。将匹配代价定义为各分量瓶颈之和，为评价一个匹配引入了跨分量的耦合，使得单一瓶颈匹配的经典算法与近似技术难以直接推广。另一方面，当把分量数 k 与代价上界 Z 联合作为参数时，问题落入 FPT，因为可以枚举各分量的瓶颈取值组合并在受限结构上求解匹配，这揭示了参数联合约束对问题可解性的决定性作用。

analysis.motivation: 该多瓶颈匹配问题在实际中来源于强同步作业车间调度与受限方向的重配置问题：在需避免碰撞的机器人/滑块重配置中，常用起止位置间的瓶颈匹配给出并行控制数的下界，但当不同智能体不能同时向不同方向移动时，单一代价值不足，需要为每条边赋予上、下、左、右四个方向的分量，从而自然得到多瓶颈匹配模型。作者因此希望从参数化复杂度与近似算法的角度刻画该问题的可解性与不可近似性边界。

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接研究多瓶颈匹配这一组合优化问题的参数化复杂度与近似性，其应用动机之一即为强同步作业车间调度，因此与生产调度方向存在明确的模型联系：论文所形式化的同步作业车间可视为各工位/工位组之间因同步约束产生的分配问题，其多方向代价向量对应重配置中同步移动方向受限的建模。迁移设想（推测）：若将生产调度中的工位分配或运输协同决策建模为带多分量瓶颈代价的匹配子问题，则本文的 FPT 联合参数算法、k/d-近似与 EPAS 可能在特定参数范围内提供理论保证；但该迁移需要满足代价向量各分量独立可估、约束可归约为完美匹配、且实例的 k 或 Z 较小等条件，论文本身并未给出面向实际调度实例的实验验证。该工作属于 AI4OR 的理论侧邻接方向，与神经网络辅助求解、强化学习或多智能体学习无直接关系。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是一个二部图上的完美匹配问题：给定二部图 G=(S∪T,E) 与向量值代价函数 c:E→N_0^k，每条边 e 的代价为 k 维向量 (c_1(e),…,c_k(e))，匹配 M 的代价定义为各分量上瓶颈值之和 ∑_{i=1}^k max_{e∈M} c_i(e)；决策版本询问是否存在代价不超过给定值 Z 的完美匹配，优化版本 min-SBMP 要求最小化该代价。决策对象是边的完美匹配选择，目标是最小化各分量最大代价之和，关键约束是匹配必须完美且二部图结构给定，信息假设为代价向量完全已知的静态离线环境；动态性、在线信息与随机性材料未说明。论文动机来源于强同步作业车间调度（每条生产线各工序须等所有工位完成上一工序才能开始）以及每步只允许单一方向移动的重配置问题中，用多方向移动需求向量构建下界。

paper.abstract: We consider a matching problem in which the cost of each edge is a vector with $k$ components. The cost of a matching is the sum of the bottlenecks over all components, and we ask whether there is a perfect matching of cost at most some value $Z$. This type of matching has applications in heavily synchronized job-shop scheduling problems and in reconfiguration problems, where movement is restricted to a single direction per step. In this paper, we analyze the problem from a parameterized complexity perspective and provide various results including FPT-membership for parameters $k$ and $Z$ combined, as well as W[P]-membership and W[SAT]-hardness for each of the two parameters individually. The reduction also implies para-NP-hardness parameterized by either maximum degree or treewidth. We further show hardness of approximation within a super-logarithmic factor for the optimization variant and provide a $k/d$-approximation algorithm for any constant $d \leq k$ as well as an efficient approximation scheme parameterized by $k$. With parameter $Z$, we show that no FPT-time $F(Z)$-approximation algorithm is possible for any computable function $F$, unless W[1] = FPT.
paper.title: Matching with Multiple Bottlenecks: Parameterized Complexity and Approximation

analysis.analysis: 作者将集体视觉导航问题形式化为一个深度强化学习问题并给出其形式化规格，把全局奖励按个体动作拆分为个体奖励以直接缓解空间信用分配难题。方法上不追求集中式大模型，而是从问题结构出发，将控制器的自动设计分解为两个阶段：先通过多智能体强化学习获得预训练的个体导航策略，再用神经进化策略对该策略参数进行优化，从而把学习信号与进化搜索结合。奖励函数通过人工信用分配设计，按前进、左转/右转、停止与碰撞分别给予不同数值，以塑造反应式避障与无地图探索行为。材料未说明作者是否使用下界、图表示或其他结构分解手段。

analysis.insight: 论文的核心洞察在于：对于集群这类需要在局部感知下涌现集体行为的场景，与其用大规模集中式模型换取表达能力，不如先用多智能体强化学习预训练一个紧凑的个体导航策略，再用进化策略在参数空间中优化该策略以适配集体目标。这样既能借助强化学习获得有效的单体验视觉导航行为，又能利用进化策略高度可并行、可扩展且对时序信用分配与解空间探索更鲁棒的特性，在极低计算与能量开销下实现鲁棒、灵活、可扩展的集体视觉导航。

method: 提出一种AI驱动的混合方法，协同结合多智能体强化学习与神经进化策略，用于自动合成集群机器人控制器。
以多智能体强化学习预训练一个个体导航策略，其参数在智能体依据局部观测执行动作后根据个体奖励更新。
使用进化策略实现——具体为交叉熵方法与协方差矩阵自适应进化策略——对预训练好的个体导航策略进行优化，以获得集体视觉导航策略。
深度架构面向低成本资源受限平台设计，采用仅依赖单目相机图像的紧凑神经网络。
奖励函数将全局奖励分解为每个智能体的个体奖励，按动作赋值：前进为5、左转或右转为0.5、停止为-1、碰撞为-10，以直接处理空间信用分配。

analysis.motivation: 集群机器人在搜索救援与环境监测等复杂动态场景中具有鲁棒、低成本的优势，但其核心难题在于如何以数据驱动方式自动设计能够产生涌现集体行为的去中心化控制器。现有依赖大型注意力模型或集中式视觉惯性SLAM的方法在内存、计算和能量上开销过高，不适合低成本资源受限的集群平台，因此作者转而探索一种高效、可扩展的混合自动设计路径。
analysis.primary_topic: 集群机器人视觉导航控制器的深度强化学习与神经进化混合自动设计
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实层面，该工作研究的是集群机器人视觉导航控制器的自动设计，核心机制是多智能体强化学习与进化策略（交叉熵方法、CMA-ES）的混合，强调去中心化、低成本、能量效率与可扩展性，属于机器人学习与神经进化交叉领域，与生产调度或AI4OR并不直接对应。迁移设想（推测）：其“先预训练个体策略、再用进化策略在参数空间优化以适配集体目标”的两阶段混合范式，以及将全局目标拆解为个体奖励以缓解信用分配的思路，在条件满足时可能迁移到分布式生产调度或多智能体协同调度中，例如把单机或单元级调度策略预训练后，用进化策略优化多智能体协同的全局目标；但需要将连续视觉观测替换为调度状态表示，将动作空间由导航动作替换为调度决策，并重新设计满足约束可行性的奖励或适应度函数，这些迁移均属推测，并非作者结论。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是为资源受限的集群机器人自动合成去中心化的视觉导航控制器，使其仅依靠单目相机图像进行无地图、无碰撞的集体探索。决策对象是同构集群中的每个智能体在每一时间步的前进、左转、右转或停止动作；目标是在不确定与动态的室内环境中最大化集体探索覆盖范围，同时保持碰撞避免与能效。关键约束包括仅使用单目相机（不使用距离传感器）、去中心化且无地图的局部感知与局部通信、面向低成本资源受限平台的计算与能量预算。信息假设为每个智能体只能获得自身对环境的局部观测，并通过个体奖励聚合为全局奖励；环境被描述为不确定且动态，属于动态环境设定。

paper.abstract: Swarm robotics presents a robust and cost-effective paradigm for advanced automation in complex, dynamic environments, such as those encountered in search and rescue or environmental monitoring. A fundamental challenge for this field is the data-driven design of decentralized controllers capable of generating emergent collective behaviors. This paper proposes a novel, AI-driven hybrid methodology for the automatic synthesis of swarm robotic controllers for autonomous visual navigation. This approach synergistically combines multi-agent reinforcement learning with neuro-evolutionary strategies, specifically leveraging implementations of the cross-entropy method and the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy to optimize a pre-trained individual navigation policy. The underlying deep architecture is engineered for low-cost, resource-constrained platforms, utilizing a compact neural network that relies exclusively on monocular camera imagery. This vision-based design emphasizes computational and energy efficiency, a critical requirement for practical swarm deployments. Experiments, performed in a high-fidelity physics simulator, demonstrate that the resulting controllers enable robust and scalable collective exploration of diverse indoor environments. The controller trained using our cross-entropy method achieves superior exploration coverage, visiting 36.20% more regions compared to the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy. Critically, our best vision-based policy achieves exploration performance statistically comparable to traditional methods relying on more expensive distance sensors, while delivering a significant 31.40% average reduction in energy consumption. These findings validate an effective and economically viable autonomous control system, establishing a path for deploying highly efficient collective intelligence in real-world engineering applications.
